newsitem.title: UK: FTSE 100 opens down despite NY gains, eyes future.
newsitem.headline: FTSE 100 opens down despite NY gains, eyes future.

text.p: The FTSE 100 started the session weaker despite early expectations of a stronger opening on the back of record Wall Street gains and a continuing squeeze in index futures.
The FTSE was 13.2 points off at 4,818.5 by 0737 GMT.
"The futures will take us up again. They are in there buying the futures now and we are within a few minutes of being up on the day," said one dealer.
Dealers expect another day of volatile trading as the futures market leads the cash market and brokerage houses continue to try and close short positions.
